title: A Harbor for the Bridge
author: A. M. Underhill
blurb: Lior Okafor, an apprentice clockmaker summoned to repair the observatory's master clock, has spent fifteen years learning which silences keep people safe. Then the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians before the armistice is signed — or isn't.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
